m: The same situation, but with a car doing it instead of a bus.
m_old: but with a car instead of a bus
P_text: A bus that is changing lanes and has the standing pedestrian on its left
Pp_text: A car that is changing lanes and has the standing pedestrian on its left
P_src:
a = scenario_or([get_objects_of_category(log_dir, category='BUS'), get_objects_of_category(log_dir, category='SCHOOL_BUS'), get_objects_of_category(log_dir, category='ARTICULATED_BUS')])
a = changing_lanes(a, log_dir)
b = get_objects_of_category(log_dir, category='PEDESTRIAN')
b = stationary(b, log_dir)
b_gate = center_distance_gate(a, b, log_dir, max_center_dist=30)  # implicit 30 m centre-distance neighbour gate, identical in P and P'
out = scenario_and([has_objects_in_relative_direction(a, b, log_dir, direction='left', within_distance=15, lateral_thresh=2.5), b_gate])
